pages.title: Dilithium Singularity
pages.text: Dilithium crystals compacted into a single point. They regulate high-energy reactions, and the singularity carries a faint thrum, as if still waiting to channel something. It glows a pale pink. Nearby energy seems to steady itself, as though being supervised.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Dilithium regulates matter-antimatter reactions. Crushing enough crystals in the Singularity Compactor, I made a single point that hums with stored control.
